minimumEvidence: Original photograph file and stable asset identifier.
Photographer/copyright-owner name and a verifiable original source or explicit publication grant; an uploader or dealer attribution alone is insufficient for manufacturer artwork.

Permission covering public website catalogue use for customers/dealers in India and UAE, hosting and redistribution of the image, and resizing/format conversion or a permitted way to serve unchanged originals. Record any required attribution, licence link, duration and restrictions.

Exact full commercial reference and matching dial, case material, case width and photographed bracelet/strap supported by the photographer's own product caption or product documentation linked to that photographed example. A nearby reference or inferred physical size is insufficient.

A clear face/bracelet photograph with the configuration visible. Optional private supporting reference-tag/caseback evidence may establish the mapping; publish only the licensed photograph and appropriate reference description.
Source URL, licence evidence and date checked captured alongside the asset; no price or stock claim inferred from a photo.
preferredRoutes: Owner-supplied original photographs with explicit publication permission and exact reference/configuration documentation.
A manufacturer/distributor asset-specific written licence expressly covering this catalogue context.
An original photographer's CC BY or CC BY-SA photograph whose exact commercial reference and configuration can be verified at the original source.
